reasons: CS4278 is offered only in Sem 1 and requires CS3263 or CS3243 completed earlier.
CS3263 is fixed in Sem 8 (Sem 2), and CS3243 is not completed, so CS4278 cannot be placed in Sem 7 or Sem 8.
Thus CS4278, CS3235 and CS3263 cannot all be scheduled under the stated constraints.
